message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The scenario: High (高某) used a brick to hit Wang (王某某) causing light injury (轻伤). This is an assault causing bodily injury. In Chinese criminal law, causing light injury by assault is "故意伤害罪" (intentional injury). The fact that he used a brick, causing light injury, qualifies as intentional injury. Also there is prior criminal record but not relevant. So the charge: "故意伤害罪". Possibly also "聚众斗殴"? But only one person used brick. The description: He and others had a dispute, he threw brick. That's intentional injury. So answer: [罪名]故意伤害<eoa>.

For assault causing injury they used "故意伤害". In earlier example: "王1某" case they gave "盗窃;非法收购、运输、加工、出售国家重点保护植物、国家重点保护植物制品". Not relevant.

Thus answer: [罪名]故意伤害<eoa>.
